structuredContent.content:
name: PoN recent batch exact-source acceptance
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/history_page.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/history_page_inline_tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/native_account_query_tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/native_authenticated_tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/current_accounts_tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/history_arithmetic.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/history_arithmetic/tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache/root_arithmetic.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache/root_arithmetic/tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/account_archive_execution/state_witness.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/tests/public_v3_multiprocess.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_fixed_blob_tests.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/tests/authenticated_storage_cli.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/examples/continuous_pipeline.rs
      - trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/tests/public_v3_service_campaign.rs
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/work_query_bound.py
      - formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_work_query_bound.py
      - scripts/ci/read_native_cache_observation.py
      - scripts/ci/test_read_native_cache_observation.py
      - .github/workflows/pon-recent-batch-acceptance.yml
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  recent:
    name: recent batch (${{ matrix.runner }}, ${{ matrix.source }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        runner: [ubuntu-24.04, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        source: [head, prospective-merge]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      RUST_TEST_THREADS: "1"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      EXPECTED_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      EXPECTED_MERGE: ${{ github.sha }}
      SOURCE_KIND: ${{ matrix.source }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd
        with:
          ref: ${{ matrix.source == 'head' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify exact source, ordered actual main merge and full repository boundary
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/recent-exact"
          mkdir -p "$out"
          echo "OUT=$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "TRNM_RETAINED_DELTA_COST_PATH=$out/retained-delta-cost.jsonl" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=$RUNNER_TEMP/target-recent-exact" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          args=(--kind "$SOURCE_KIND" --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD")
          if test "$SOURCE_KIND" = prospective-merge; then
            args+=(--expected-base "$EXPECTED_BASE" --expected-merge "$EXPECTED_MERGE")
          fi
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py "${args[@]}" --output "$out/source.json"
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/operator_mining_owner.rs)" = 44acbb5d854a8e0a7c4979b4715bd9949b656cd5
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/operator_continuous_owner.rs)" = a6eb85aa2c2e3ad17244890128ef86975d71ecc9
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/operator_continuous_owner_tests.rs)" = 6119f98bb45fda6399d2528db9f61a69751e397f
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store.rs)" = 70e42fd48d21755af43c5157c89ebfe5f09663ce
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/history_page.rs)" = abb5f3193ee4d7f02633be4e3f6fdd3e1365a5e9
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/native_authenticated_tests.rs)" = c98c5333ab3609b30b11fd0a700917ce7f2a8999
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated.rs)" = e99453b1abe6ce589f003be199b5553241cba398
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/task_observation.rs)" = eed2c350e3dfd17a66d7c4f4225ee2f02d3c0e60
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_fixed_blob_tests.rs)" = 5e3769d3186026a7bac012be534f0d6cad5e362a
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/tests/authenticated_storage_cli.rs)" = 7301aeb3033913f080b23767bfca52a2bf76d45b
          test "$(git hash-object formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/work_query_bound.py)" = e3ec8bf4bdd510f3fe718e63a4df595d342c61c6
          test "$(git hash-object formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_work_query_bound.py)" = 526f155f2215184aa607da6d453423ca6930ded2
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/native_account_query_tests.rs)" = c8567475a36cf449d9fd2b33363a545fbd4704ab
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache.rs)" = 79a7c0ab6812d5a536f551241cee9a12ebdfb494
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache/root_arithmetic.rs)" = 3fcbc873fcc89de208922e6ffd74361442797bed
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/arithmetic_cache/root_arithmetic/tests.rs)" = 74af81e2e181f6639dd1719a65d91c0ba5323c9b
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/account_archive_execution/state_witness.rs)" = 0f611459c4c1c37488861ba36c82ba8302e40c4c
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/history_arithmetic.rs)" = 6540d88dc33064ab504607bfa9b7340d42a3c585
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/src/store/native_authenticated/history_arithmetic/tests.rs)" = 27b6342619ee051c57944de88b4bbab33ff4627c
          # Retain R10 and the subsequent bounded 30-second client-import
          # observation under the original budgets, with an exact whole-file pin.
          test "$(git hash-object trillionnium/crates/trnm-pon-node/tests/public_v3_multiprocess.rs)" = ec6420becaba837f22d45c917d15554a8e653275
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
      - name: Execute conditional query accounting and anytime-bound counterexamples
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 formal/pon-nakamoto-v1/test_work_query_bound.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/query-bound.log"
          grep -E '^Ran 21 tests in ' "$OUT/query-bound.log"
          grep -x 'OK' "$OUT/query-bound.log"
      - name: Reject incomplete, ambiguous or incorrectly bound cache observations
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci -p test_read_native_cache_observation.py -v 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/cache-receipt-tests.log"
          grep -E '^Ran 34 tests in ' "$OUT/cache-receipt-tests.log"
          grep -x 'OK' "$OUT/cache-receipt-tests.log"
      - name: Install original pinned native compiler and lint tools
        run: rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component rustfmt --component clippy
      - name: Prepare pinned OpenSSL 3.5.9 PQ provider
        id: pq_provider
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TRNM_CI_RECEIPT_DIR="$OUT"
          bash scripts/ci/prepare_pq_provider.sh
      - name: Check committed formatting without rewriting source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 fmt --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml --all -- --check 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/format.log"
      - name: Require bounded ordinary record copies and complete history controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib store::fixed_blob_read_tests:: -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/fixed-read-suite.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 4 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/fixed-read-suite.log"
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib store::history_page:: -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/history-read-suite.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 6 passed; 0 failed; 3 ignored;' "$OUT/history-read-suite.log"
          grep -Fx 'test store::history_page::tests::inline_record_tests::history_inline_record_types_widths_and_error_precedence_match_original ... ok' "$OUT/history-read-suite.log"
          grep -Fx 'test store::history_page::tests::inline_record_tests::history_inline_record_complete_pages_and_foreign_corruption_match_original ... ok' "$OUT/history-read-suite.log"
          for selector in store::fixed_blob_read_tests::fixed_blob_copy_preserves_null_types_and_exact_boundaries store::fixed_blob_read_tests::fixed_header_projection_bounds_all_six_fields_without_type_coercion store::fixed_blob_read_tests::fixed_record_rereads_original_errors_and_restores_both_native_backends store::fixed_blob_read_tests::fixed_context_and_active_tip_reject_oversize_prefix_aliases store::history_page::bounded_record_tests::history_record_copy_bounds_keep_original_conversion_and_shape_order; do
            log_file="$OUT/${selector//:/__}.log"
            printf '%s\t%s\n' "${log_file##*/}" "$selector" >> "$OUT/log-paths.tsv"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$log_file"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$log_file" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Execute complete original error-boundary suite and all new controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib store::error_boundary_tests:: -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/error-boundary.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 13 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/error-boundary.log"
          for test in recent_batch_exact_window_and_complete_call_observation recent_batch_retained_corruption_and_read_boundary_match_original recent_batch_branch_reopen_and_callback_errors_preserve_context; do
            selector="store::error_boundary_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Execute all original authenticated owner controls and five snapshot regressions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib store::native_authenticated_tests:: -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/native-snapshots.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 21 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/native-snapshots.log"
          for test in native_dense_snapshots_retain_64_and_reconstruct_pruned_history native_dense_snapshot_insert_corruption_and_delta_omission_roll_back native_dense_snapshot_pruning_suppression_preserves_atomic_limit native_dense_snapshot_cannot_hide_old_delta_damage_from_admission native_dense_snapshot_readback_cost_keeps_full_state_and_unaccelerated_reference native_inactive_page_parents_use_checked_material_without_early_activation native_inactive_parent_material_keeps_fresh_sql_state_and_cancellation_checks; do
            selector="store::native_authenticated_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Retain authenticated record, ancestry and cold recovery coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for suite in store::native_authenticated:: store::native_ancestry_commit_tests::; do
            name="${suite//:/_}"
            options=()
            if test "$suite" = store::native_authenticated::; then
              options+=(--include-ignored)
            fi
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$suite" -- "${options[@]}" --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$name.log"
            grep -E '^test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed; 0 failed;' "$OUT/$name.log"
            if test "$suite" = store::native_authenticated::; then
              grep -E '^test result: ok\. 91 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/$name.log"
              # Inspect this invocation once; retain all existing executions.
              python3 - "$OUT/$name.log" <<'PYLOG'
          import re, sys
          from pathlib import Path
          lines = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines()
          names = [m[1] for line in lines if (m := re.fullmatch(r'test (store::native_authenticated::[A-Za-z0-9_:]+) \.\.\. ok', line))]
          summaries = [line for line in lines if line.startswith('test result:')]
          post_write = [name for name in names if name.startswith('store::native_authenticated::post_write_readback::tests::')]
          current_accounts = {
              'store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::cold_complete_reuses_actual_account_parse_and_keeps_all_graph_checkpoints',
              'store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::current_projection_is_bound_to_exact_state_and_never_hides_account_changes',
              'store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::current_projection_preserves_complete_root_and_late_error_priority',
              'store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::current_projection_rereads_corrupt_sql_and_preserves_every_cancellation',
              'store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::cold_full_validation_projection_abba_observation_without_timing_gate',
          }
          observed_current = {name for name in names if name.startswith('store::native_authenticated::current_accounts_tests::')}
          if (len(names) != 91 or len(set(names)) != 91 or len(post_write) != 23
                  or observed_current != current_accounts
                  or len(summaries) != 1 or not summaries[0].startswith('test result: ok. 91 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;')):
              raise SystemExit('current authenticated module requires 68 non-post-write and 23 post-write executions, including all five current-account controls, in one log')
          PYLOG
            fi
          done
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --test continuity_authenticated --test authenticated_storage_cli -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/recovery.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 7 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/recovery.log"
      - name: Require all five statement-reuse controls and complete-call observations separately
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in cached_delta_reads_rebind_and_observe_committed_mutations cached_delta_failure_then_rollback_does_not_reuse_a_verdict cached_delta_cursor_is_released_after_cancellation cached_delta_eviction_or_disabled_cache_keeps_original_results cached_delta_complete_call_observation_keeps_checks_and_results; do
            selector="store::native_authenticated::stored_delta_stream_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Require every cached block, parent, commitment and snapshot owner control
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in cached_block_reads_do_not_hide_genesis_damage_or_rollback cached_parent_reads_observe_changed_work_then_exact_restore cached_commitment_reads_preserve_limits_missing_and_rollback cached_genesis_snapshot_is_reread_and_survives_cold_reopen; do
            selector="store::native_authenticated::cached_owner_read_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Require live public owner mutation, admission rollback and cold reopen controls
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in live_owner_rechecks_genesis_block_after_committed_damage_and_restore live_owner_rechecks_parent_work_after_real_admission live_owner_rechecks_record_limits_missing_rows_and_sql_types live_owner_snapshot_damage_rolls_back_admission_and_rejects_cold_open; do
            selector="cached_owner_reads::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --test authenticated_storage_cli "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Require fixed-BLOB allocation bounds with original errors and rollback semantics
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in fixed_blob_projection_bounds_owned_bytes_and_preserves_sql_types fixed_block_fields_match_original_errors_after_warm_cache_and_rollback fixed_parent_work_matches_original_and_rereads_after_restore fixed_fields_genesis_failure_order_and_cold_reopen_keep_state stored_packet_blob_copy_bound_preserves_sql_types_and_boundary stored_packet_reads_keep_legacy_errors_provenance_and_restoration stored_packet_reads_keep_pq_errors_provenance_and_restoration stored_packet_digest_borrows_full_blob_and_preserves_conversion_errors; do
            selector="store::native_authenticated::native_fixed_blob_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Reject empty nullable BLOB corruption through original native owners
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in nullable_delta_projection_preserves_null_empty_types_and_bounds nullable_delta_empty_bytes_are_not_absence_after_warm_cache nullable_delta_late_failure_keeps_cancellation_and_cursor_recovery nullable_genesis_packet_empty_rejects_and_rollback_restores nullable_real_insertion_empty_preimage_rejects_live_and_cold_owner; do
            selector="store::native_authenticated::nullable_blob_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Keep settings-selected task observations and original legacy readback
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in configured_profiles_decode_transfers_acceptances_and_reject_foreign_or_malformed_bytes every_native_profile_observes_real_settlement_with_its_exact_wire_id legacy_selection_and_ambiguity_keep_the_original_codec_order; do
            selector="store::task_observation::tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
          for test in exact_acceptance_survives_restart_and_cli_readback_without_mutation settlement_in_another_packet_never_rescues_a_reorged_exact_packet receipt_only_and_ambiguous_multi_accept_packets_have_no_upgrade_binding altered_current_task_bytes_cannot_become_a_settlement_observation; do
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --test accepted_task_observation "$test" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$test"
          done
      - name: Preserve operator packet authorization and complete stored digests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for selector in store::operator_mining_owner::tests::mining_owner_packet_reads_preserve_gates_errors_and_journal store::operator_continuous_owner::tests::continuous_owner_packet_reads_preserve_gates_errors_and_journal; do
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/${selector##*::}.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/${selector##*::}.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Bound initialization intent reads and reject path substitutions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          for test in initialization_marker_preserves_exact_context_errors initialization_marker_recovery_and_cold_reopen_preserve_state initialization_marker_rejects_special_files_and_post_precheck_substitution initialization_marker_read_is_bounded_and_propagates_io_errors; do
            selector="store::init_marker_tests::$test"
            cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib "$selector" -- --exact --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/$test.log"
            python3 scripts/ci/check_required_native_test.py "$OUT/$test.log" --test "$selector"
          done
      - name: Preserve original source-preserving migration coverage
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --lib authenticated_migration -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/migration.log"
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. [1-9][0-9]* passed; 0 failed;' "$OUT/migration.log"
      - name: Preserve pending confirmation ownership and joined shutdown on failures
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo +1.95.0 test --release --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml -p trnm-pon-node --example continuous_pipeline -- --show-output --test-threads=1 2>&1 | tee "$OUT/pipeline-failure-controls.log"
          # Eleven retained controls plus the two later failure/panic ownership controls.
          grep -E '^test result: ok\. 13 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$OUT/pipeline-failure-controls.log"
